name: ANSI/IEEE polarised relay coil symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for polarised relay coil, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The polarised-relay form indicates a documented sensitivity to input polarity or direction. The schematic's terminal labels and polarity reference must remain intact when the element is rearranged, because page orientation does not establish electrical polarity.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Use terminal data to determine the operating polarity.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Polarised operation differs from the polarity restriction introduced solely by a suppression diode on an ordinary relay coil.
